main_text.l: E casibus reliquis similes sunt nomi-
definit in ι: genitivus dualis in ιν, plu-
lo masculino ὁ, fœminino ἡ, neutro
τό. Neutrum habet in omni nume-
cet, est neutrum, ut τέκνον filius aut fi-
lia, ὁ θυγάτριον filiola. In cæteris fo-
appareat, genus est commune, ut ὁ
ὄνος asinus asina, ὁ χὴν ἡ ἔλαφος cervus
cerva: si sexus non pateat, genus est
simplex, ut ὁ ἀετὸς aquila, ἡ χελιδὼν hi-

page.notes: Greek accents and breathings in the lines "ὁ ὄνος", "ὁ χὴν ἡ ἔλαφος" and "ἡ χελιδὼν" are doubtful at this scan resolution; "θυγάτριον" and "τέκνον" are copied as seen. The word "foemas" in the line beginning "In cæteris" is likely a misprint for "mas" and is left as read; the scan is also blurred at the line ends. Printed hyphen at "hi-" is retained; the word continues on the next page. Bottom slash mark is a stray stroke, not text.
